story.title: Story 6: Reopen and Degraded Source State

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified the quick-fix for SV-06-01 by inspecting the new unavailable-source read-model redaction layer, confirming both project and process read paths serialize through it, and checking the new route-level TC-6.2a proofs. Re-ran focused tests plus the configured story and epic gates on the updated tree.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `buildSourceAttachmentReadSummary` now nulls stale hydration fields and strips refresh metadata for unavailable rows (`apps/platform/server/services/sources/source-read-models.ts:10-29`), and both the project-shell and process work-surface readers serialize through that layer (`apps/platform/server/services/projects/summary/source-summary.builder.ts:7-10`, `apps/platform/server/services/processes/readers/materials-section.reader.ts:83-92`). New route-level TC-6.2a tests assert the real GET payloads redact those fields for both `/api/projects/:projectId` and `/api/projects/:projectId/processes/:processId` (`tests/service/server/projects-api.test.ts:334-400`, `tests/service/server/process-work-surface-api.test.ts:633-749`).

additionalObservations: Focused follow-up tests passed: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/service/server/projects-api.test.ts tests/service/server/process-work-surface-api.test.ts tests/service/client/source-management-ui.test.ts`.
TC-6.2a now has real route/read-path proof for both project-shell and process work-surface payloads, so the prior anti-shim evidence gap is closed.
